Perfect agreement on claims C40-C43 regarding assembly efficiency effects of internal motif mutations. Both evaluations find the evidence SUPPORTED, with peer reviewers noting initial concerns about interpretation were adequately addressed.

Perfect agreement on claims C44-C47 regarding sufficiency of either signal for assembly. Both evaluations find the evidence SUPPORTED, with peer reviewers affirming the comprehensive in vitro and in vivo approach solidifies conclusions.

Perfect agreement on claims C48-C49 regarding differential effects of position 0 vs position 6 mutations on intrinsic folding. Both evaluations find the evidence SUPPORTED, with peer reviewers satisfied by clarification of discrepancies between in vitro and in vivo assays.

Perfect agreement on claims C50-C53 regarding stalled assembly intermediates for Y286A mutant. Both evaluations find the evidence SUPPORTED using multiple complementary methods (BN-PAGE, antibody gel-shift, urea extraction).

Perfect agreement on claims C54-C59 regarding BamA and BamD recognition of both signals. Both evaluations find the evidence SUPPORTED, with peer reviewers noting initial concerns about strengthening interaction claims were rigorously addressed.

Perfect agreement on claims C60-C64 regarding neutron reflectometry data showing substrate positioning. Both evaluations find the evidence SUPPORTED, with peer reviewers satisfied by elaboration on rationale and interpretation of NR data.

Strong agreement on cross-linking data (C65-C67), though peer review R8 also covers C68-C71, C89 which OpenEval addresses separately in R9-R10. Both find photo-cross-linking evidence SUPPORTED for mapping distinct binding regions on BamD.

OpenEval R9 addresses disulfide cross-linking (C68-C69, C89) while peer R8 covers broader cross-linking findings (C65-C71, C89). Both evaluations find the evidence SUPPORTED as part of rigorous biochemical approaches providing compelling evidence.

OpenEval R10 addresses in vivo photo-cross-linking and structural interpretation (C70-C73) while peer R8 covers broader cross-linking data. Both find evidence SUPPORTED, with partial overlap on C70-C71.
Perfect agreement on claims C74-C77, C91 regarding BamD's chaperone function promoting beta-strand pairing. Both evaluations find the evidence SUPPORTED through disulfide bond formation assays.

Significant disagreement on claims C78-C81 regarding BamD mutant phenotypes. OpenEval finds evidence SUPPORTED, but peer reviewers express UNCERTAINTY, specifically noting lack of explanation for differential vancomycin sensitivity between BamD R197A and Y62A mutants.

Agreement on vancomycin sensitivity data (C83-C85) with both finding evidence SUPPORTED. OpenEval R13 also covers C7, C82 not addressed in peer R11. Both affirm functional importance of internal signals for membrane integrity.

Agreement on central mechanistic conclusions (C4-C6) with both finding evidence SUPPORTED. OpenEval R14 covers broader integrated conclusions (C4-C6, C92-C94) while peer R13 focuses on C4-C6. Both affirm rigorous evidence for internal motifs' critical role.

Partial overlap on C93-C94 regarding functional significance and assembly rates. Both evaluations find evidence SUPPORTED, with peer reviewers noting the novel concept has been tested and verified for model OMPs.
